body: Reaction work plan (4 parts). P3: reactionHeightOffset = size.height + 14 at ChatListViewCells.swift:5165/5421/5614 -> strip needs only height + 4 gap (strip sits at bubble.maxY-6-h; bottomPad 6 for text, 0 fullbleed, 7 voice). P2: ChatReactionChipView.apply background for isMe must be opaque appearance.textColorMe (+ count colour = bubbleMeGradient.first, clear border). P4: overlay gestureRecognizerShouldBegin vetoes taps inside bubbleSnapshot.frame; snapshot INCLUDES the reaction strip, so tapping the pill never dismisses - pass the strip rect in snapshot coords into the overlay and let it through. P1: expand = swap picker content to search row + 8-col catalog grid (promote ChatEmojiEntry/Category/CatalogBuilder from private in ChatGifPanel.swift), overlay layoutMenus expanded branch pins panel at safeTop, pushes bubble to panel.maxY+gap, hides contextMenu.
